SH-10 (held) - Payer class: episodic, per-visit, or managed care. Determines which financial-risk rule applies to a missed visit; the direction of risk differs by class.
column4: HOLD - reimbursement research. Class taxonomy may need to be finer than three values once managed Medicare variants are mapped. Would require a new Shared-layer category, Authorization & Payer - do not create it yet.

column1: SH-11 (held) - Hospital discharge date, distinct from our admit date. Some benefit windows start at discharge, so elapsed days consume benefit never used.
column4: HOLD - reimbursement research. Which payers behave this way is exactly what the research must establish.

column1: SH-12 (held) - Payment period and case-mix group. Under episodic payment the unit is a 30-day period, and two sit inside one 60-day certification period.

SH-13 (held) - LUPA threshold: minimum visits a period must reach to be paid the period rate rather than per-visit. Group-specific and recalibrated annually, so reference data rather than configuration.
S-51 (held) - Period utilization against payment: the ceiling counterpart to the LUPA floor. Above the floor, further visits may be cost without matching revenue.
column4: HOLD - reimbursement research. Posture would be Read: margin consequence may be displayed and must never weigh against clinical need. Also requires cost-per-period data finance has not supplied.
